newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ryan Hotels says outlook for full-yr good.
newsitem.headline: Ryan Hotels says outlook for full-yr good.

text.p: Ryan Hotels Plc said on Wednesday it expected a strong outturn for the full year and its markets in both Ireland and the continent continued to be strong.
"The strong trading conditions are continuing and we look forward to an excellent result for the full year," chairman Conor McCarthy said in a results statement.
The group reported an increase of 31 percent in half-year pre-tax profit to 1.6 million punts. It announced an increase of 25 percent in its interim dividend to 0.625 pence per share.
McCarthy said Ryan's branded products had another successful period with increased volumes in all markets, and particularly in the UK where room sales rose by 35 percent year-to-date.
Ryan said the company's strategy of superior quality put it in a strong position to meet competition from the increasing number of low priced hotel developments offering basic facilities.
